invented_method_choices: MC-1 directions tier: the packet stamps C-tiers on claims[] but NOT on directions_of_use, which §2.4/§7.13 require. Convention adopted: German-language pack-style directions for a German-market product whose brand owner has an identified C1/C2 German source are treated as C1/C2 (directions_tier_basis: assumed_pack_or_C2, unstamped); directions available only in English from a non-German brand or retailer context are C5 and yield ROLE unknown / usage_role []. See AMB-02.

MC-2 COND establishing set (§10.2.1): where several routes could establish COND, the establishing set is the minimal set that clears the COND anchor, choosing the NON-film route (cationic and/or emollient) first, so that a dedicated persistent-silicone or cationic-polymer film system remains available as the additional observation. Adopted because §10.2.1's own first bullet requires `smoothing` to be reachable for a dedicated silicone film system. See AMB-03.

MC-3 §18 has no string for EXPO = aromatic_or_allergen_exposure, for scalp_application_fit = conditional, or for a shake instruction on a non-two_phase product; no string is emitted in those cases. See AMB-06.
MC-4 The §18 row 'HUM humectant counter-signal' is NOT emitted: §10.1.1/G14 and §18's own register rule forbid a string emitted by a counter-signal. See AMB-07.
MC-5 §8.4 LAYER gives no emission trigger, so no LAYER caution string is emitted on any record. See AMB-08.
